title: Калькулятор (переменные)
semantics: Proposal pending owner approval; not current runtime support. Scalar expression mode with integer/real/string/boolean/datetime/variant. Refer to an earlier expression by bare name, e.g. base+1; Expr.limit-Expr.skip is also accepted in 7.4.2. Intermediate expressions feed later expressions but are excluded from output variables 0. replace=true requires an exact input-variable name and intermediate=false; total+10 reads incoming total and replaces its value and label at the same output position, preserving all other inputs. expression_order is a complete name permutation of saved expressions and preserves existing output mapping. Omitted properties retain their saved values. Civil datetime preserves milliseconds without UTC conversion; Variant retains declared type and runtime subtype. Execute/read variable_ports:[0], ports:[], Save separately.

parameter_schema.description: Proposal: scalar variable expressions, intermediate flag, input replacement and explicit expression order. New nodes require expressions; saved-node reorder can supply expression_order alone.

expressions.description: 1–32 expression changes; input replacement must use the exact incoming variable name. Unlisted expressions and output mapping stay unchanged.

items.description: Ordered scalar expression patch, including optional intermediate flag; unlisted saved expressions stay unchanged.

target.description: Choose one new or existing expression.

kind.description: new adds a variable; existing patches one saved expression.

name.description: Exact saved expression name; required only for existing.
Technical output name. Required for new; existing omission preserves it.

label.description: Display label independent of name. Required for new; omission preserves existing.

type.description: Output type; no inference. Required for new; omission preserves existing.

formula.description: Native Loginom expression. Use bare earlier names, e.g. base+1; Expr.name is also accepted. Civil datetime: EncodeDateTime; Variant retains its runtime subtype.

description.description: Optional expression description; omission preserves existing.

intermediate.description: Intermediate expressions can feed later expressions but are excluded from output variables. Omission preserves the existing flag; new defaults to false.

replace.description: Replace the incoming variable with the same exact technical name; formula reads its incoming value. Requires intermediate=false. Changed label is the expression label; preserve all other variables and output order. Omission preserves the saved flag, new defaults to false.

expression_order.description: Complete permutation of all expression names after patches, each exactly once. Changes expression order only; preserve existing output-variable mapping and order. Omission preserves saved expression order. Do not silently change formulas to permit a dependency move.
